[ASSISTANT_SAID] Recommended local Swiss dishes for visitors to Zürich:  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] 1. Zürcher Geschnetzeltes (sliced veal in cream sauce)  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] 2. Rösti (shredded potato dish)  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] 3. Fondue (melted cheese dish)  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] 4. Raclette (melted cheese dish served with potatoes, pickles, and onions)  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] 5. Älplermagronen (a hearty pasta dish with cheese and potatoes)  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] 6. Zürcher Eintopf (meat and vegetable stew)  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] 7. Zopf (Swiss braided bread)  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] 8. Luxemburgerli (Swiss macarons)  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] 9. Swiss chocolate (Lindt, Toblerone, Cailler are some popular brands)  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] Noted that there are many international restaurants in Zürich.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] Recommended specific restaurants in Zürich that serve traditional Swiss cuisine:  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] 1. Zeughauskeller: Serves classic Swiss dishes such as Zürcher Geschnetzeltes and Rösti.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] 2. Swiss Chuchi: Offers a modern take on traditional Swiss cuisine, including cheese fondue, Raclette, and Älplermagronen.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] 3. Walliser Kanne: Serves Swiss specialties such as cheese fondue, Zürcher Eintopf, and Rösti.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] 4. Restaurant Swiss Chuchi: Serves traditional Swiss dishes such as cheese fondue and Rösti.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] 5. Fischer's Fritz: Serves Zürcher Geschnetzeltes and other Swiss dishes, as well as fresh seafood.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] Suggested making a reservation, especially during peak tourist season.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] Recommended vegetarian and vegan restaurants in Zürich:  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] 1. Hiltl: One of the oldest vegetarian restaurants in the world with a wide variety of vegetarian and vegan dishes.
